summary: The current release of the SPAM catalog, along with all previous versions, is hosted on the SPAM catalog site. That is where the photometry catalogs and the photometric redshifts live, together with the README, PSFs, depths, completeness, and template libraries.
contents: Photometry — source positions, morphology, and fluxes in every filter (Kron plus twelve circular apertures)
Photometric redshifts — a fiducial run plus EELG, circular-aperture, broadband-only, and WFC3 variants
Supporting products — README and data model, segmentation map, empirical PSFs, 5-sigma depths, survey area, and completeness
